items.statement: Pharmacist-led follow-up reduces severe toxicity and unplanned toxicity admissions in the first 90 days of oral anticancer treatment, at the cost of a small fall in relative dose intensity.
items.rationale: Admissions are the outcome that matters to patients and drives costs (claims c3, c4).
items.risks: Few trials report admissions; historical comparisons dominate.

items.statement: Reported adherence gains will be largest with self-report and smallest with electronic caps.
The cost of a pharmacist-led service for 480 patients a year is of the same order as the admissions it may avert, with a range that includes both net cost and net saving.
items.rationale: One budget range overlaps the clinic's cost (claim c5).
items.risks: Costs from one centre may not transfer.

summary: Three hypotheses, one per strand; h1 selected as the patient-important strand.
